title: Setting OpenFeature flags in tests via setTestFlags
answers: How do I enable a feature flag in a test?
How to mock an OpenFeature flag value in Jest tests?
Test still reads old config.featureToggles value after migration
body: Once a flag is migrated to OpenFeature, tests must set it via `setTestFlags({ [FlagKeys.X]: true })` from `@grafana/test-utils/unstable` instead of `config.featureToggles.X = true` (the latter no longer affects components using the OpenFeature client). Reset flags between tests with `afterEach(() => setTestFlags())` to avoid leaking flag state across test cases.
applies: Tests for any component reading a flag through getFeatureFlagClient() or a useFlagX hook.
